description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Grain' and a generic subclass 'Grain<TGrainState>' used in the Orleans distributed application framework. It provides core functionality for grain lifecycle management, state handling, timers, and runtime interactions.

classes.name: Grain
classes.description: Abstract base class for all grain classes in Orleans, providing lifecycle management, runtime access, and deactivation/timer support.

classes.name: Grain<TGrainState>
classes.description: A subclass of Grain that manages persistent state through an IStorage implementation, including state reading, writing, and migration lifecycle handling.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method called during grain activation; can be overridden to perform custom activation logic.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method called during grain deactivation; can be overridden to perform cleanup.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer callback to invoke periodically; marked obsolete in favor of a new overload.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Marks the grain to be deactivated when idle.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Initiates migration of the grain's activation to a new placement asynchronously.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays or cancels the deactivation timer based on the provided duration.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state from the backing store into Memory.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists current state into the backing store.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears current state from the storage.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Called during state rehydration phase in lifecycle; sets up storage and reads state.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Called during lifecycle end; typically for cleanup.
